description: Beaver local-assistant tools, pre-2026-07-31 navigation shape: read by section or character offset, unscoped search, no cross-reference tool. Edit scopes are whole_document / find_text / range, so naming a place for an edit means retyping exact document text.

tools.note: No filter. The product strips the address parameters and the address edit scope itself under this environment; the runner records the served schema hash so a regression that reintroduces them is visible in the receipts rather than masked here.

description: Beaver local-assistant tools, one address grammar plus progressive disclosure: `at` on read, search and cross-references, head/tail reads, page schemes, a cross-reference tool, and an edit scope that names a provision or page instead of retyping its text.
Ablation: the library/address grammar with progressive disclosure removed; the whole catalogue ships in the first request.

Coding-agent grammar plus the same address-backed structure and progressive disclosure: Glob/Grep/Read/Edit over filenames; Glob discloses document IDs only when duplicate filenames require disambiguation.
Ablation: the coding-agent grammar with progressive disclosure removed; the whole catalogue ships in the first request.
